lessons.title: Be safe on the trip
lessons.en:
Mum: Anna, you and Ben will travel alone next week. Be safe!
Anna: Don't worry, Mum. We'll follow all the rules.
Mum: Remember the family phone number. Stay away from danger.
Anna: I'll be careful. We'll also watch for warning signs.
Ben: Yes! Safety first.
lessons.cn:
妈妈：安娜，下周你和本要单独旅行，注意安全！
安娜：放心妈妈，我们会遵守规则。
妈妈：记住家里电话，远离危险。
安娜：我会小心，会留意警示牌。
本：对，安全第一。

lessons.title: Safety on the road
lessons.en: Travel is fun, but safety always comes first. Always cross the road with the green light. Don't talk to strangers. Carry a small bag with water, a map and a phone. Read warning signs at scenic spots and follow the rules. Remember a family phone number — call right away if you get lost. A safe trip is a happy trip!
lessons.cn: 旅行有趣，但安全第一。绿灯过马路。不和陌生人说话。带小包装水、地图、电话。看景区警示牌、守规则。记住家人电话——迷路马上打。安全的旅行才是快乐的旅行！
